sections.title: How to Play
sections.text: A repeatable Dungeon mode that puts your DPS to the test. Deal as much DMG to the Boss as possible within the time limit. The more DMG you deal, the better your rewards will be during settlement.

sections.title: Elemental Rotation
sections.text: The Boss's defensive element in Final Mirage rotates weekly in this order: Ghost, Undead, Water, Earth, Fire, and Wind, allowing Adventurers to equip specific cards and elemental conversion items to counter the current attribute. Note that the elemental rotation only affects the Boss's own defensive element, while its skill damage remains Ghost, and the defensive elements of its summons remain unaffected.

sections.title: Basic Rules
sections.text:
Participants:
Form a Party (1-5 players) to challenge
Attempt Limit:
No limit on challenge attempts
Reward Claims:
2 times per week
Death Penalty:
Each Party member's death deducts 5s from the Dungeon countdown. A full Party wipe deducts an extra 10s. After a full wipe, all members revive immediately at the spawn point.

sections.title: Reward Rules
sections.text:
1. Reward claims reset to 2 every Monday at 5:00 AM. All Dungeon levels share these reward attempts.
2. Deal at least the minimum required DMG to choose whether you want to claim rewards during settlement. Claiming rewards consumes 1 reward attempt.
3. The more DMG you deal to the Boss, the higher your rating and the better your rewards. You can challenge the Boss repeatedly to push for better stats and rewards.
4. If you don't manually exit the Dungeon before settlement, you will automatically claim your rewards.

sections.title: Assist Rewards
sections.text:
1. After you use all your reward attempts, further challenges count as Assists and grant Assist Rewards.
2. You can earn Assist Rewards up to 2 times per day. You will not receive rewards beyond this limit.

sections.title: Rankings
sections.text:
1. The Final Mirage Leaderboard ranks Parties based on Dungeon Level, damage dealt (number of Boss HP bars depleted), and clear time.
2. Ranking rewards are distributed and ranking data is reset every Monday at 5:00.
3. You can receive at most 1 ranking reward during the distribution. If you appear in multiple Party rankings, you will only receive the reward for your highest rank.

sections.title: Ranking Attempts
sections.text:
1. Every Monday at 5:00, 10 Ranking Attempts will be refreshed.
2. Each challenge of the Final Mirage Instance consumes 1 Ranking Attempt.
3. To record your results on the Rankings, every member of the Party must have at least 1 Ranking Attempt remaining upon entry.
4. If any Party member lacks Ranking Attempts, the final data for the entire Party will be ineligible for the Rankings.

leaderboard.note: Ranking rewards are distributed every Monday at 5:00

skills.name: Death Gaze
skills.desc: Unleashes a sweeping ring of ranged physical DMG around you, inflicting Petrify on Hit

skills.name: Dark Orb
skills.desc: Summons a barrage of energy Bullets that deal ranged physical DMG and inflict Darkness on Hit

skills.name: Smash
skills.desc: Leaps high and slams into the ground, dealing Melee Physical DMG to the surrounding area and inflicting Stun

skills.name: Shadow Servants
skills.desc: Summons four Shadow Servants and gains Invincibility while they remain alive. The four servants are: a Bigfoot that takes massively increased Melee Physical DMG, an Orc Archer that takes massively increased Ranged Physical DMG, a Greatest General that takes massively increased Magic DMG, and a Deviruchi that takes massively increased DMG from all sources while afflicted by Status Effects.

skills.name: Shadow Might
skills.desc: Each time Shadow Osiris loses a certain amount of HP, it deals massive AoE Ranged Physical DMG and gains an Attribute boost

variants.warning: Defeat all monsters to remove the Boss's invincibility. Watch their weaknesses!

skills.name: Abyssal Surge
skills.desc: The Baron calmly waves his umbrella, elegantly summoning waves from all directions. Players hit will suffer an additional Knockback effect. Dodge carefully!

skills.name: Phantom Spring
skills.desc: The Baron swings his umbrella once more, summoning water spheres from all directions that converge into a central geyser. Players hit will suffer an additional Confuse effect. Dodge carefully!

skills.name: Abyss Gaze
skills.desc: The Baron's skills (excluding Basic Attacks) inflict a Stun effect on hit. Dodge carefully!

skills.name: Phantom Portals
skills.desc: The Baron opens 4 otherworldly portals that continuously spawn minions. Defeated minions leave behind a damaging zone that lasts for 20s. While the portals are active, the Baron is Invincible. Prioritize destroying the portals to stop the minions!

skills.name: Shadow Might
skills.desc: Upon losing a certain amount of HP, the Shadow Owl Duke deals massive AoE Ranged M.DMG and gains Attribute boosts. When its HP falls below 20%, its damage output and DMG Reduction are significantly increased.

variants.warning: Destroy all portals to break the Boss's invulnerability!
The Boss has gained Shadow Might, its attributes greatly boosted!
